text:
Rosalind Tavner founded the Quillfeather Archive, according to the Quillfeather Charter of Establishment, a document she signed and filed with the Merrowdene Civic Records Office.

The Archive's founding was formally recorded on 14 March 1987. Tavner began the collection with 2,300 donated manuscripts and pamphlets.

Desmond Okafor-Hale, Registrar of the Merrowdene Historical Society, certified the founding record.

"The charter leaves no doubt about who established the Archive or when," Okafor-Hale said. "Rosalind Tavner put her name to it, and the record was certified in accordance with our procedures."

The Charter remains on file at the Civic Records Office, where it forms the basis of the Archive's official history. The collection Tavner began with those donated papers has remained a point of local pride in Merrowdene.
